decision: 5 second time penalty (2 penalty points awarded, 9 points for the 12 month period)
event_name: Time 22:30 2018 SINGAPORE GRAND PRIX 13 - 16 September 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Breach of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations and of Appendix H, Article 2.4.5.1 (d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence and determined that car 8, Romain Grosjean ignored blue flags, which were shown for a significant number of corners.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Doc 35 2018 Singapore Grand Prix Offence Car 8 Ignoring Blue Flags
to: The Team Manager, Haas F1 Team
